diagram_previews.alt: Two externally tangent circles with centres A (larger) and B touching at C. The common external tangent touches them at X and Y. Red segments CX and CY meet at C with a right-angle mark, grey dashed radii go to X and Y, and the blue dashed common tangent at C meets XY at its midpoint M. A thin leader line joins C to its label.

difficulty_rationale: An unstated approach requiring some exploration and a few connected steps.
